title: Menus, categories, and dishes
intro: Configure what appears on the ordering screen: dishes, menu groupings, and categories.

sections.title: Dishes
steps: Open the Dishes tab.
Create or edit dishes with price, categories, modifiers, and recipes.
Import CSV files for bulk dish or ingredient updates when needed.
sections.caption: Dishes tab.

sections.title: Menus
sections.intro: Menus control which dishes are visible on each service period or channel.
steps: Open the Menus tab.
Assign dishes to menus and set availability windows.
Save changes so floor staff see updated items on the Menu screen.
sections.caption: Menus tab.

sections.title: Categories
steps: Open the Categories tab.
Group dishes for navigation on the ordering screen.
Reorder categories to match how staff browse the menu.
sections.caption: Categories tab.

sections.title: Modifier groups
sections.intro: Modifier groups define optional add-ons, sizes, and nested choices shown when staff customize a dish.
steps: Open the Modifier groups tab.
Create groups with modifiers, prices, and optional next-group rules.
Assign groups to dishes so the cart shows the correct customization flow.
sections.caption: Modifier groups tab.

sections.title: Dish form
sections.intro: Dishes are sellable items with price, categories, modifiers, recipes, and kitchen routing.
steps: Open Admin → Menus → Dishes and add or edit.
Set number, name, price, cost, and categories.
Attach modifier groups, inventory recipe lines, kitchen, and workflow.
Save — dish appears on menus and POS immediately when active.
sections.caption: Dish maintenance form.

fields.name: Price / cost
fields.effect: Selling price and theoretical food cost.

fields.name: Recipe lines
fields.effect: Inventory depletion when the dish is sold.

fields.name: Kitchen / workflow
fields.effect: Routes KOT printing and prep stages.

sections.title: Menu form
sections.intro: Menus time-box which categories appear on POS (e.g. lunch vs. dinner).
steps: Open Menus tab and add or edit.
Set name and optional start/end times.
Toggle active and ends-on-next-day for overnight menus.
Assign categories on the Menus list after saving.
sections.caption: Menu form with service hours.

fields.name: Ends on next day
fields.effect: Allows service past midnight into the next calendar day.

fields.name: Active
fields.effect: Inactive menus are hidden from POS.

sections.title: Category form
steps: Open Categories and add or edit.
Set name, sort priority, and show-in-menu flag.
Save — assign dishes and link to menus.
sections.caption: Category form.

fields.name: Name
fields.effect: Category header on POS and reports.

fields.name: Show in menu
fields.effect: When off, category is hidden from customer-facing menu views.

sections.title: Modifier group form
sections.intro: Groups define modifiers, prices, and nested follow-up groups per choice.
steps: Open Modifier groups and add or edit.
Set name, priority, and modifier lines with prices.
For each modifier configure allowed next groups.
Use next group overrides to hide or reprice nested modifiers.
Save and attach the group to dishes.
sections.caption: Modifier group form with nested groups.

fields.name: Name / priority
fields.effect: Group label and order when multiple groups attach to a dish.

fields.name: Modifier
fields.effect: Selectable option (often a dish used as add-on).

fields.name: Price
fields.effect: Extra charge when the modifier is chosen.

fields.name: Allowed next groups
fields.effect: Which modifier groups open after this choice (nested flow).

fields.name: Next group overrides
fields.effect: Per nested group: override nested modifier price or hide items.
